headline: Rotated layouts now survive: VIEWTWIST and the header UCS are read, written and exported

verdicts.label: R12 · R13 · R14 · R2000 · R2004 · R2007 · R2018
verdicts.note: all OPEN + AUDIT 0 errors in AutoCAD 2027 (gated)

verdicts.label: Saved view: VIEWTWIST + VPORT record
verdicts.note: 36 of 36 fields agree with AutoCAD DXFOUT on nine drawings across R14/R2000/R2007/R2018 — the twist was never decoded before and the walk drifted one BD from there on

verdicts.label: Header UCS
verdicts.note: UCSORG/UCSXDIR/UCSYDIR were read and thrown away; captured now, written back, and carried through DXF as $UCSORG/$UCSXDIR/$UCSYDIR

verdicts.label: R2007: empty CLASSES payload
verdicts.note: AC1021 refuses it exactly as AC1032 does — the stub record now goes out from R2007 on

verdicts.label: R2007: inline ACIS framing
verdicts.note: the payload starts on the BIT after its version field, then a flag and the cached wireframe block — measured on genuine records, both hidden by a reader that probes for the magic

verdicts.label: R2007: kernel dialect
verdicts.note: AC1021 reads only the pre-ASM binary form inline; an ASM stream now leaves as SAT or is reported

verdicts.label: random_seed at record 0x100
verdicts.note: retired as a blocker: five drawings saved from five separate AutoCAD launches carry the identical value — it is a per-process RNG draw, not a function of the file

verdicts.label: Page slack is a generated stream
verdicts.note: one MT19937 init array per file feeds every slack region and the seven envelope fields; its content is free (zeroed + re-parity'd audits clean)

verdicts.label: Provenance: AcDs section
verdicts.note: 4429 lifted bytes replaced by a hand-written emitter — still AUDIT 0/0, no thumbnail bytes

verdicts.label: Provenance: header keystream run
verdicts.note: 20 copied bytes now generated from the LCG (stream index = file offset)

verdicts.label: Provenance: 3DSOLID bit tail
verdicts.note: decoded field by field (the GUID was a plain UUIDv4) — 163 bits, all computed, AUDIT 0/0

verdicts.label: R2007 ACAD_TABLE record
verdicts.note: the one entity AC1021 output cannot carry: the inline grid every other pre-R2010 container takes is refused there, with cell text and without it — reported in skipped, never dropped silently

verdicts.label: Licence + provenance audit
verdicts.note: no third-party file or code in the tree (hash-verified); PROVENANCE.md + NOTICE state the method

verdicts.label: R2007 Reed-Solomon parity
verdicts.note: rsEncode used one generator for both codes — fixed, now byte-exact on 102 headers + 1231 pages + 55189 blocks

verdicts.label: Whole-file recompression
verdicts.note: genuine files fully recompressed and re-encoded by us: AUDIT 0 errors (180 KB file, 2600 objects)

inflight: A real drawing found the next defect: an AC1014 site plan laid out at 45 degrees drew turned, because the whole rotation lives in two fields the library dropped. VIEWTWIST was never decoded at all — and because the walk skipped it, every field after it drifted one BD, which is why snapBase and gridSpacing used to come back as 6e-294 and 1e-314, and why the view direction and target came back swapped. The header UCS was read and discarded outright. Worst of the three, the DXF writer then put a hard zero in group 51: not missing data a consumer could handle, but a confident "this drawing is not rotated". The record layout was pinned bit for bit with AutoCAD DXFOUT as the oracle, and now grades 36 of 36 fields on nine drawings.
recentlyLanded: VIEWTWIST, the viewport UCS and the whole VPORT record read, written and round-tripped — graded 36/36 against AutoCAD
Header UCS captured instead of discarded, and written back by every DWG writer and the DXF writer
viewTwistTransform and ucsTransform: the transform that squares a rotated drawing, measured rather than assumed
